title: API Device-App v1 - ban tin du lieu
description: Payload MQTT publish len topic quic4iot/{device_id}/data. Tai lieu day du: docs/API_Device_App.md. Schema KHONG kiem duoc: tong kich thuoc payload == target_size, device_id trung voi topic, seq lien tuc - collector tu kiem cac dieu nay (muc 8).

device_id.description: Ma thiet bi, vd pi01, esp01; <= 8 ky tu, chu thuong va so

seq.description: So thu tu ban tin (uint32), bat dau 0 moi lan chay, tang 1 moi ban tin duoc tao

ts_us.description: Thoi diem gui, micro giay ke tu 1970-01-01 UTC, lay ngay truoc publish. Toi da 2^53-1 de khong mat do chinh xac khi doc bang JavaScript
